original: アメリカも本音と建前を使い分ける国だ。

en.text: America is also a country that separates its public motives from its private ones.
America is also a country that separates its public face from its private one.
America is also a country that separates what one says and does in public from what one says and does behind closed doors.
America is also a country that separates public actions and statements from private ones.
